explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 58 named tracks, releases, reviews and catalogue references across live September 2026 Juno, Boomkat, Resident Advisor and Bandcamp windows; Damage Music's current Sinee remixes; Type-303's Cold Blow debut; Max F's overlooked 2026 Peace World catalogue; and current canonical inside-out boundaries. Written metadata and attributed descriptions only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Runs 169–191 artist and release fields were not recycled. Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, prior unresolved titles, unselected alternates and exact utility-ledger identities were excluded.
The immediately prior Stroom, Metempsychosis and Planet Rhythm fields were excluded, as were already-recorded Alexander Holm, Flaminia and Jon Head identities.
The scan covered current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue material. Nine exact-title leads survived without padding.
Every placement pair was re-derived from the current 52-track ledger and checked for adjacency and prose agreement. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer sequence remains untouched.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
